description: Test file for the 'resource' package, specifically testing the 'int64Amount' type and its methods such as AsInt64, Add, Mul, AsCanonicalBytes, Sign, and AsScaledInt64.

classes.name: int64Amount
classes.description: A struct representing an amount with a value and scale used for resource calculations.

methods.name: AsInt64
methods.description: Converts the int64Amount to an int64, considering its scale.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds another int64Amount to this one, handling scale differences and overflow.

methods.name: Mul
methods.description: Multiplies the int64Amount by an int64, handling scale and overflow.

methods.name: AsCanonicalBytes
methods.description: Returns the canonical string representation of the amount and its exponent.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Returns the sign of the amount: -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: AsScaledInt64
methods.description: Converts the amount to a scaled int64, considering the target scale.
